summary: Test suite is incomplete and references non-existent files. Missing critical fixtures (fixtures/case1 and fixtures/case2) and workflow file (.github/workflows/test-results-aggregator.yml) that tests assert exist, causing test failures. Missing tests for CLI features: --out flag handling, GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY environment variable integration, and command-line argument edge cases. Workflow.test.ts has environmental brittleness (requires actionlint installed). Core logic (JUnit/JSON parsers, aggregation, markdown rendering) is well-tested with good error case coverage. But CLI and workflow integration lack rigor. Would not catch regressions in --out flag, env var handling, or file I/O operations.
